label: Vite + React + TypeScript
description: A single-page web app: Vite, React and TypeScript, with Vitest and a README.
task: Scaffold a Vite + React + TypeScript single-page app in this empty folder. Create package.json with the scripts dev (vite), build (tsc -b && vite build), preview (vite preview) and test (vitest run); index.html; vite.config.ts; tsconfig.json; src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx with a small working page, and src/App.css. Set up Vitest with @testing-library/react and jsdom, with one test for App. Add a .gitignore for node_modules and dist, and a README.md that says what the app is and how to install, run, test and build it.

create.note: Run it in the new folder before you press Run; the run then builds on what it created.
